harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created an SSH host certificate authority on node1 and configured sshd to present a CA-signed host certificate. Verified a client trusting only the CA public key (no host-key pinning) connects and accepts the host via certificate trust. Restarted node1 using the native safe reboot mechanism, confirmed a changed boot_id, and re-verified sshd, the certificate, and CA-based client trust all recovered correctly post-restart.
actions_performed: Generated an ed25519 SSH CA keypair at /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca on node1
Signed the existing ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub as a host certificate with principals node1, 10.100.236.10, localhost, validity 52 weeks
Added HostCertificate directive via /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-host-cert.conf and validated with sshd -t
Restarted sshd and confirmed via sshd -T that the host certificate is active

Verified from a client (node1 itself acting as SSH client) using a known_hosts containing only an @cert-authority line for the CA pubkey (no pinned host key) that the connection trusts the host via the certificate
Captured pre-restart boot_id, sshd status, and certificate file state as baseline
Issued shutdown -r now in background so acknowledgement returned before disconnect, confirmed the exec stream dropped as expected
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again and confirmed boot_id changed (4ebdfa06... -> 8bcdc368...), proving an actual restart
Re-verified post-restart that sshd is active, the host certificate file and sshd -T config are unchanged/valid, and the CA-trust client test still succeeds

evidence.requirement: SSH CA created on node1
evidence.summary: ssh-keygen generated CA keypair at /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca with fingerprint SHA256:i6quK3mhXHedMVogSzn2a/fznms92eYxAEVi1m/QvwQ

evidence.requirement: Host key signed by CA into a certificate
evidence.summary: ssh-keygen -s signed ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub producing ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub with matching CA fingerprint, principals node1/10.100.236.10/localhost, valid 2026-09-29 to 2027-09-28

evidence.requirement: sshd configured to present the certificate
evidence.summary: Added HostCertificate directive, sshd -t passed, sshd restarted and sshd -T confirms hostcertificate directive active

evidence.requirement: Client connects trusting CA without pinning host key
evidence.summary: SSH client with known_hosts containing only '@cert-authority * <CA pubkey>' (no host key entry) reports 'Host is known and matches the ED25519-CERT host certificate'

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline for node1
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 4ebdfa06-919e-48a9-8a15-475d9007662c, sshd active, host cert file present, sshd -T shows hostcertificate

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Backgrounded shutdown -r now returned control to shell before the connection dropped (subsequent probes then failed as expected)

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart in progress / unavailable window
evidence.summary: Exec probes failed with connection timeout then connection reset while node1 was rebooting

evidence.requirement: Node1 changed boot identity proving actual restart
evidence.summary: Exec succeeded again with new boot_id 8bcdc368-e420-42fb-9164-7efb80b947e3, differing from pre-restart baseline

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of sshd and certificate config
evidence.summary: sshd active, sshd -T shows hostcertificate directive intact, cert and CA files present, sshd -t validates config

evidence.requirement: Post-restart CA-based client trust still functions
evidence.summary: Client using only CA pubkey (no pinned host key) again confirms 'Host is known and matches the ED25519-CERT host certificate' after reboot
